WAS blitzes 46% and Purdy is +0.70 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=47) against +0.30 clean, so the heat feeds Evans (25 targets, 377 air yards over the last 3) and Kittle (19 targets) while CMC (41 carries, 195 rush yards) handles lead-protection runs. WAS's QB is -0.20 EPA vs blitz (n=55) into a SF defense that blitzes 31%, allows 3.69 YPC and only 9 passes of 20+ on 184 attempts, so WAS drives stall and Diggs's targets stay empty.
script.flip1: SF jumps ahead by two scores early, kills the clock with CMC and Kaelon Black (16 carries, 46 yards over the last 3), and Evans/Kittle second-half yards stall — the favorite-runs-the-clock flip.
script.flip2: WAS hangs within a score or leads, both sides throw, and it becomes a shootout: Evans, Kittle and McLaurin (139 rec yards on 14 targets) clear together while CMC's rush volume dips. A weather slog cannot be tested — the forecast was not saved.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost. Evans went under because SF led by two scores at half, the +0.70 blitz EPA showed up as CMC carries rather than deep shots, and Evans finished in the mid-40s — the clock-kill flip — and the pack never split the 223 yards, so one spike game plus two quiet ones would have made 65.5 a trap. Diggs went over because WAS abandoned Croskey-Merritt's 39-carry role once they trailed, Daniels dumped 10 targets to his most-targeted receiver, and one crosser the uncharted SF slot coverage didn't have in the 9-of-184 explosive count got Diggs to the mid-40s; a McLaurin scratch this pack cannot see would do the same. That counter is real but not stronger than the base read: a -7 / 51.5 price is a one-score SF lead with WAS still scoring, not a 17-point halftime bury, and Diggs still needs both a target spike and a chunk play against a defense with no location soft spot. Evans stays a lean, tagged as dying only on the blowout flip.
slip_story: Efficiency-gap stack, not a total and not a TD ticket: SF's pass game is the real one and WAS's is empty calories. Evans over and Diggs under co-occur when SF scores near its 29 implied points through the explosive/middle hole while WAS's leading target (16 targets, 68 yards) cannot separate against a secondary allowing 5.89-6.38 YPA. Do not add a same-game total under, a Kittle over, or a Daniels rush over — those need the blowout, the shootout, or the scramble flip this pair does not.
